title: Custody Evaluation Session (Court-Ordered or Stipulated Evaluator)
what_it_is: A session with a mental-health or other behavioral-science professional the court has ordered or the parties have stipulated to, as part of a custody evaluation. MCL 722.27(1)(d) authorizes the court to use community resources in behavioral sciences and consider their recommendations; a completed custody-evaluation summary is a separate downstream member (custody-evaluation-summary).
who_is_in_the_room: The evaluator - a licensed professional, working under a court order or stipulation, not a treating clinician for you.
You, and separately the child and the other parent at other sessions (format varies by evaluator and order).
sequence: The court orders (or the parties stipulate to) a custody evaluation, typically specifying the evaluator and scope (MCL 722.27(1)(d)).
The evaluator conducts individual sessions with each parent, may observe parent-child interaction, and may interview collateral sources.
The evaluator prepares a report with findings and, often, recommendations tied to the best-interest factors.

The report becomes evidence only through the process the case's own order or the evidence rules require - PROVISIONAL, confirm the admissibility path for this specific evaluator's report with the assigned judge/referee.
prepare: Understand and, if unclear, ask in writing what the evaluation's scope and confidentiality terms are before the first session.
The same factual chronology used elsewhere - do not present a different narrative to the evaluator than to the FOC or the court.
A calm, factual account of parenting routine, involvement, and any concerns, without diagnosing the other parent.

applicable_rules.summary: The court may utilize community resources in behavioral sciences in the investigation and study of custody disputes and consider their recommendations.

deadlines.label: Evaluation report due (case-specific; no general statutory day-count located)

traps.trap: Assuming the session is confidential the way therapy is.
traps.safe_move: A court-ordered evaluation is not confidential from the court; assume anything you say may appear in the report.

traps.trap: Bringing a prepared script instead of answering naturally.
traps.safe_move: Evaluators are trained to notice rehearsed answers; be factual and consistent instead of scripted.
Describe specific, dated conduct and its effect on the child; do not diagnose (GUARDRAILS.md S2).

traps.trap: Letting the child sense the evaluation is a contest to win.
traps.safe_move: Do not coach, debrief, or ask the child what was said (GUARDRAILS.md S8, absolute).

do_not: Never characterize the other parent with a clinical label as a pleaded claim (narcissist, alienator, PAS, coercive control) - GUARDRAILS.md S2.
Never use the child as a witness, messenger, interviewee, or source, and never record the child - GUARDRAILS.md S8, absolute.
Never assert that any recording you made is lawful - Michigan law is unsettled and the exposure is criminal.
Never sign or stipulate to anything on the spot without reading it fully first.

openers: Good morning/afternoon, Your Honor. My name is [Party], and I am representing myself.
I am here to address [narrow issue]. I have [N] exhibits and a short chronology.
closers: I don't have that information, but I can provide records if needed.
I'd like the record to reflect [narrow, factual point] and I reserve my right to address anything broader in the appropriate forum.

safety_gates: immediate danger -> 911, do not proceed on this guide alone
PPO/DV/CPS contact live -> stop, safety resources, do not proceed on this guide alone
UCCJEA/interstate fact -> stop, MC 416 affidavit guidance
recording question in any form -> unsettled law, criminal exposure, attorney question only
child asked/expected to speak to anyone about the case -> stop
exit_checklist: Write down the date, who appeared, and what was decided or taken under advisement before leaving the building.
Write on any document handed to you the date you received it - that date can start a clock.
Calendar every deadline this event started, counted from the earliest possible trigger date.
Note whether anything was requested that you did not have time to answer fully, and follow up in writing.
PROVISIONAL - confirm the evaluator's report-admissibility path (stipulation, MRE, or order) with the assigned judge/referee before relying on any finding in it.
